page.overview:
Who is Mike Burch?

Charles Lambert "Mike" Burch (born 29 April 1907 and died 11 July 1981) was an American racing driver who tried, unsuccessfully, to qualify for the 1950 Indianapolis 500. During that time, the Indianapolis 500 was counted towards the Formula One championship, so his results would have been included in the 1950 Formula One season.
